bio.text: Scott Petersen, an Omaha business owner, won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary for Nebraska Secretary of State, defeating incumbent Bob Evnen.
He has never held elected office; he is a former chair of the Douglas County Republican Party and was a delegate to the 2024 Republican National Convention.
He also serves on the Nebraska Republican Party's executive committee.

sources.title: Evnen out as Nebraska secretary of state
Scott Petersen challenges Nebraska Secretary of State Bob Evnen from right
